### 2026-10-10 – I worked on the starbie, following the instructions of the guide and understanding how each thing works, at first, I got some problems installing the XIAO Seed Library but after installing the package

**3h**

I worked on the starbie, following the instructions of the guide and understanding how each thing works, at first, I got some problems installing the XIAO Seed Library but after installing the package, i started connecting the microcontroller and also creating and connecting the buttons (SW_Push). Im finishedwith every of that and I'm starting with the screen to display my character (OLED pin)
